Good morning, residence order for this week

* 8 boxes Foley catheter 2-way silicone-coated latex 18 Fr
* 5 boxes hypodermic needles 18G 40mm
* 5 bottles hand sanitiser gel 1 litre refill
* 50 foam dressings 10x10 with border
* 1 box sterile latex surgical gloves size 7.5
* 6 bottles aloe vera after sun gel 200ml
* 19 boxes wooden tongue depressors for children

Deliver to the usual entrance please
